gates.title: Per-image licensing, archive capture, and public availability
worker_findings: Rights holder recorded: Microsoft Corporation. Creator: Microsoft (VB6 documentation). Access method: anonymous public HTTPS, no boundary crossed. Credit text drafted.

The ASSET_PLAN lead ('Wikipedia Visual Basic article, Wikimedia Commons ... these exist on Wikipedia') was checked: the only VB6 IDE image on the Wikipedia article is a non-free, fair-use-tagged local en.wikipedia file (not on Commons), so the plan's implied free availability is not supported. No Commons file inspected shows a VB6 IDE.

No file-specific license permits reuse. Microsoft Learn Terms of Use restrict copying images; Microsoft's screenshot permission may permit an unaltered, uncropped, resized screenshot in a video with 'Used with permission from Microsoft.', but its applicability to a documentation figure is not stated. Evidence cannot settle this; it is a legal-risk question.
gates.reason: Unknown rights stay blocked (R14). Rights review question handed to the producer for the review deck.
